title: Studying African Farmer-Led Irrigation Survey
hook: The data this week comes from the SAFI (Studying African Farmer-Led Irrigation) survey, a subset of the data used in the Data Carpentry Social Sciences workshop. So, if you're looking how to learn how to work with this data, lessons are already available! Data is available through Figshare. CITATION: Woodhouse, Philip; Veldwisch, Gert Jan; Brockington, Daniel; Komakech, Hans C.; Manjichi, Angela; Venot, Jean-Philippe (2018): SAFI Survey Results. doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.6262019.v1 SAFI (Studying African Farmer-Led Irrigation) is a currently running project which is looking at farming and irrigation methods. This is survey data relating to households and agriculture in Tanzania and Mozambique. The survey data was collected through interviews conducted between November 2016 and June 2017 using forms downloaded to Android Smartphones.
